limitations: Candidate scan, not proof of universal absence of secrets or personal information.
No base64/compression/archive decoding, natural-language identity inference or reconstruction of hidden data.
Derived offsets refer to decoded views; JSON structural paths use object-key order and array indices without echoing private key names.
Public installation paths and intentional technical examples remain findings until root classification; evidence is never removed automatically.
A NO_CANDIDATES result is not a product PASS, suite result, remote CI check or authorization to publish.
